About WebStore Pro

WebStore Pro is a web studio that builds modern websites for small businesses: online stores, restaurants, cafés, shops and service companies.

Every website we make is built for phones first, loads fast and makes it easy for customers to message you.

We reply quickly, explain things in simple words and give a clear price before we begin.

Questions? Quick answers.

How long does it take?

A one-page website is usually ready in a few days. A business website or online store takes longer. We give you a date before we start.

Do I own the website?

Yes. Once you have paid, the website is fully yours.

What do I need to give you?

Your business name, a few photos, your prices or menu, and your WhatsApp number. If you have no photos, we help you.

Can I ask for changes?

Yes. During the build you can ask for changes, and you see progress all the time.

What do domain and hosting cost?

They are billed separately from the website price, at cost. We tell you the exact amount before you decide, so there are no surprises.

How do I pay?

You pay nothing to start. You see your website first, and you pay only when you love it.
